articles.headline: Rueben Chinyelu comes up big and No. 3 Florida escapes with a 76-67 win against Milwaukee
articles.description: — Rueben Chinyelu posted his first double-double of the season and made the first 3-pointer of his college career as No. 3 Florida escaped with a 76-67 victory against Milwaukee on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Colorado rallies from 20-point deficit, beats Stanford 70-65 at Acrisure Series
articles.description: — Barrington Hargress had 19 points on 7-of-8 shooting, Justin Neely scored 16 and Colorado overcame a 20-point deficit and beat Stanford 70-65 on Tuesday night at the Acrisure Series.

articles.headline: No. 22 Gonzaga routs Kansas State 101-61 in Players Era 16 first round
articles.description: — Massamba Diop scored 18 points and grabbed seven rebounds as No. 22 Gonzaga routed Kansas State 101-61 on Tuesday night in the opening round of the Players Era 16 tournament.

articles.headline: Louisville's Kelsey tells 5th-year critics 'bring it' as Trimble shines in upset
articles.description: After Seth Trimble led Louisville to a 72-64 win over No. 5 Texas Tech, Cardinals coach Pat Kelsey told critics of teams using fifth-year players, "Everybody can have their opinion. Bring it."

images.name: Seth Trimble [600x400]
images.caption: Seth Trimble scored 24 points in Tuesday's win over No. 5 Texas Tech that gave Louisville its first victory over an AP top-five opponent under coach Pat Kelsey.

articles.headline: No. 13 St. John's beats Oregon 90-79 in opening round of Players Era 16 tournament
articles.description: — Ian Jackson scored 21 points as part of a balanced effort by No. 13 St. John's, which beat Oregon 90-79 on Tuesday night in the opening round of the Players Era 16 tournament.

article.headline: Tre White scores 21 as No. 11 Kansas rallies past West Virginia 86-82 in Las Vegas
article.description: — Tre White scored 21 points, including four crucial free throws in the final 39.6 seconds, and No. 11 Kansas held off West Virginia 86-82 in the semifinals of the Players Era 8 tournament Wednesday.

article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Tre White scored 21 points, including four crucial free throws in the final 39.6 seconds, and No. 11 Kansas held off West Virginia 86-82 in the semifinals of the Players Era 8 tournament Wednesday. Trey Kaufman-Renn scored 19 points for the Jayhawks (5-0), who will face No. 8 Houston in Thursday's championship game. Keanu Dawes added 18 points and Leroy Blyden Jr. contributed 13. Freshman guard Miles Sadler led the Mountaineers (4-1) with 34 points. Martin Somerville came off the bench to hit four 3-pointers and score 16 points. West Virginia led 82-81 with 1:26 remaining after Kaufman-Renn made one of two free throws. Following a missed 3-pointer, White was fouled with 39.6 seconds left. He made both free throws to give Kansas an 83-82 lead. Sadler missed a jumper, and White was fouled again with 15.2 seconds remaining. He converted both free throws to extend the Kansas lead to 85-82. The Mountaineers led by 11 points in the second half and held a 68-58 advantage with 11:15 remaining. However, the Jayhawks went on a 10-2 run to cut the deficit to 70-68 with 7:18 left. Kansas took a 72-71 lead on a three-point play by Blyden with 5:45 remaining. Freshman Tyran Stokes, a preseason All-Big 12 selection, sat after suffering an injury Tuesday against UNLV. Coach Bill Self said Stokes had a bone bruise. West Virginia took its first lead on a 3-pointer by Sadler, going ahead 20-19 with 11:05 left in the first half. The Mountaineers led 49-44 at halftime. Wednesday's meeting between the Big 12 foes did not count in the conference standings. They'll meet again when West Virginia visits Allen Fieldhouse on Jan. 2. Up next The Jayhawks get Houston, which knocked off No. 1 Florida earlier Wednesday.
